review_notes: I reviewed the whole file: `ringCatSheaf`, the `PresheafOfModules` abbreviation and `Hom.toRingCatSheafHom`. I grepped Mathlib for other definitions of the underlying sheaf of rings of a scheme and for its morphism-level counterpart. I found none. `ringCatSheaf` is the only definition of this concept. It is used in `Modules/Sheaf.lean` and `Modules/Tilde.lean`. The `PresheafOfModules` abbreviation just specialises the existing `PresheafOfModules` to `X.ringCatSheaf.obj`. It is a named specialisation and not a competing concept. `toRingCatSheafHom` is built from `Functor.whiskerRight f.c` and is used to define pushforward and pullback. I found no independent duplicate declaration. I did not run any Lean code.
